_meta.status: DRAFT — every risk level must be reviewed by a registered dietitian before public release

risk_levels.none: No known concern at normal intake
risk_levels.low: Approved; no meaningful concern at normal intake
risk_levels.moderate: Approved, but with a warning label abroad, a sensitivity issue, or limited evidence of harm
risk_levels.high: Banned or withdrawn elsewhere, or classed as a possible carcinogen

_meta.animal: yes = animal-derived; maybe = can be animal- or plant-derived; no = not animal-derived
